name: form4api-mcp
description: Production-grade SEC Form 4 insider trading data for Claude Desktop. Amendment-aware, 10b5-1 clean, with Form 144 intent-to-sell and institutional 13F-HR overlay. One MCP that replaces multiple scrapers.

api_key.title: Form4API API Key
api_key.description: Get a free key at https://www.form4api.com — free plan includes 500 requests/day, no credit card required.

tools.name: research_company
tools.description: Bundled AI-ready insider-research context for a ticker: company profile, recent transactions, cluster signals, sentiment, and a computed buy/sell summary in one call.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Search SEC Form 4 insider transactions with filters for ticker, insider, date range, transaction codes, and 10b5-1 plan exclusion.

tools.name: get_recent_filings
tools.description: Get the most recent SEC Form 4 filings, optionally filtered by ticker.

tools.name: get_filing
tools.description: Get a single Form 4 filing by its SEC accession number.

tools.name: get_insider_profile
tools.description: Get an insider profile by CIK — name, title, director/officer/10pct owner flags.

tools.name: get_insider_transactions
tools.description: Get all Form 4 transactions for a specific insider by their CIK.

tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Get company profile — name, CIK, SIC sector, state of incorporation, website, filing counts.

tools.name: get_company_insiders
tools.description: List all insiders who have filed Form 4s for a company.

tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: Cluster buy/sell signals — multiple insiders at the same company in the same direction, 10b5-1 excluded. Requires Business plan.

tools.name: get_sentiment
tools.description: Monthly insider-sentiment score for a ticker (MSPR-style, -100 to +100), 10b5-1 excluded. Requires Business plan.

tools.name: get_form144
tools.description: Form 144 intent-to-sell filings — early signal ~2 days before the Form 4 sale lands. Requires Business plan.

tools.name: get_holdings
tools.description: Institutional positions from Form 13F-HR — filter by ticker, manager, quarter, or minimum value. Requires Business plan.

tools.name: get_managers
tools.description: Institutional manager index with latest AUM — partial name match supported. Requires Business plan.

tools.name: get_insider_career_summary
tools.description: Aggregate career rollup for an insider: total bought/sold, top companies, 10b5-1 split, return averages. Requires Pro plan.

tools.name: get_insider_scorecard
tools.description: Buy track-record scorecard for an insider — hit rate and avg/median return on discretionary buys. Requires Pro plan.

tools.name: get_insider_leaderboard
tools.description: Top insiders ranked by hit rate or avg return; filter by horizon, min_trades, and limit. Requires Business plan.

tools.name: search_insiders
tools.description: Substring search on insider names — returns matching insider profiles and CIKs.

tools.name: check_usage
tools.description: Check current API key usage stats — plan name, requests today, daily limit, all-time count.

tools.name: get_key_usage
tools.description: API key usage stats in OpenAPI response shape.

tools.name: get_key_activity
tools.description: Recent API requests made with this key.

tools.name: get_usage_history
tools.description: Daily request counts for the last N days.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List companies sorted by name or filing count.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List your active webhook subscriptions.

tools.name: get_webhook_events
tools.description: Replay webhook delivery events since a given timestamp.
